power_status: Remove multiple battery framework We seem to have a framework that allows DUTs to have multiple batteries. Nothing actually uses this though, presumably since no DUTs actually have multiple batteries. We may as well make things simpler, and if anyone needs this functionality later then they can add it. power_status: Improve battery_charging() If either linepower or the battery thinks were charging, then we probably are. Some devices don't give the status field of linepower, but they do give the status field of the battery. My Sarien for instance does not have linepower.status, and this was the impetus for this CL, because the old ac_charging() function did not work on Sarien (it said not charging, when in fact it was charging). If this breaks any tests by changing the behavior, then those tests are flawed: They thought that the DUT was not charging, when it really was. While were at it, rename ac_charging() to battery_charging(), because that's what really is happening, and simplify the |= logic. power_BatteryDrain: Add client utility test This test drains the battery quickly, as a utility for other tests. It turns the screen and keyboard backlight up as high as possible, and then opens Chrome to a WebGL heavy webpage. It requires that AC power is not supplied, so you will have to turn it off via servo in a server test. You can specify a battery threshold to drain to, and a timeout in seconds. On my Sarien device this puts the battery drain rate at about 35 watts, as compared to about 6 when sitting idle at the login screen with a medium backlight. In conjunction with a USB power load tester (https://amzn.com/B01LKT0OTQ) that draws an additional 10 watts, the DUT drains at about 1% a minute. For the policy_DevicePowerPeakShift and policy_DeviceAdvancedBatteryChargeMode tests that I am writing, which require the DUT to be at about 95% battery (so they can charge), this only takes about 5 minutes. BUG=b:139201701, b:138940522, b:143173004 TEST=test_that -b sarien \ --args='drain_to_percent=90 drain_timeout=300' $DUT power_BatteryDrain Change-Id: Id7373d7b929cfdf3d71ffde37ef3d5dea501bfc7 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1867569 Tested-by: Nick Crews (Nov 1 last day) <ncrews@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Daniel Campello <campello@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Todd Broch <tbroch@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Shawn N <shawnn@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Derek Beckett <dbeckett@chromium.org>

chameleon: Stability improvements for raspberryPi on sending HID reports Raspberry pi failed to send HID reports after reconnecting from DUT. For example: 1. DUT pair with raspPi 2. DUT connect with raspPi 3. DUT disconnect with raspPi 4. DUT connect with raspPi 5. raspPi send a HID report at the 5th step, the sending will fail because with error 'connection reset by peer'. This patch fix the bug by recreating the socket when the exception raise.
